how_to_apply: Send the application with all certificates and required documents only by registered post or by hand, obtaining a receipt from the office.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Minimum educational qualification as per the UGC (Minimum Qualifications for Appointment of Teachers and Other Academic Staff in Universities and Colleges and Measures for the Maintenance of Standards in Higher Education) Regulations, 2018; Minimum 55% marks at postgraduate level; minimum 50% for SC, ST and Divyangjan candidates Age limit: Maximum 65 years Other conditions: For Swami Atmanand English Medium Model Colleges: English-medium teaching experience and ability to resolve students' queries in English are compulsory If two candidates of the same category tie in the merit list, native residents of Chhattisgarh get preference

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DB Girls College Raipur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: A guest lecturer whose services end on complaint in a session will not be eligible for teaching in coming academic sessions

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Service ends automatically when the post is filled by new appointment, regular posting or transfer Service will not be a basis for future regularisation Not counted in the college establishment and not a public servant Arrangement ends automatically on 15 days' continuous absence Services may be terminated immediately on complaints

content_sections.text: Merit list prepared as per rules from applications received by the last date Post-wise provisional merit list Claims and objections Final list Provisional merit list on the college notice board and website; claims and objections till 19-11-2026; final list on 20-11-2026

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Domicile (native resident) certificate 10th and 12th certificates Graduation and postgraduation certificates SET/NET certificate M.Phil/Ph.D. certificate Experience certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DB Girls College Raipur Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Send the application with all certificates and required documents only by registered post or by hand, obtaining a receipt from the office. Application must reach by 13-11-2026, 5:00 PM, during office hours. Write on the sealed envelope the address Principal, Govt. D.B. Mahila Snatakottar Mahavidyalaya Raipur and the subject/post applied for. Applications sent by email will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Affidavit at joining: no criminal case pending, not in any other government/semi-government service, not earlier removed on complaint Selected candidate not reporting at the place of duty in time will not be included in further stages Must assist in admission tests, student union elections, cultural programmes, sports, internal exams and NAAC work

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DB Girls College Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DB Girls College Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Guest Lecturer (Music).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DB Girls College Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (To be prepared by applicant as per advertisement details) and send it to Principal, Government Dudhadhari Bajrang Mahila Snatakottar (Swashasi) Mahavidyalaya, Kalibari Chowk, Raipur (C.G.), by registered post or by hand (obtain receipt from office), to reach by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 2000 per working day, maximum Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum qualification as per UGC Regulations, 2018; minimum 55% marks at postgraduate level (50% for SC, ST and Divyangjan candidates).

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. For Swami Atmanand English Medium Model Colleges: English-medium teaching experience and ability to resolve students' queries in English are compulsory. If two candidates of the same category tie in the merit list, native residents of Chhattisgarh get preference.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A guest lecturer whose services end on complaint in a session will not be eligible for teaching in coming academic sessions.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list prepared as per rules from applications received by the last date. Post-wise provisional merit list. Claims and objections. Final list.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Service ends automatically when the post is filled by new appointment, regular posting or transfer. Service will not be a basis for future regularisation. Not counted in the college establishment and not a public servant.
